description: Format/version words: bit i is the i-th module written by the oracle's _draw_format_bits/_draw_version on a bare symbol. Symbols: the real constructor with automatic mask (-1); penalties are its eight _get_penalty_score results in trial order, final the finished module grid (metadata included). Symbol data as in the correction vectors; GitHub and tie payloads go through encode_segments with one BYTE segment and ECC boost disabled. Penalty grids: the oracle's _get_penalty_score on hand-built grids. Grid hex as in the matrix vectors.
